t: What fasting is worth without the rest
a: مَنْ لَمْ يَدَعْ قَوْلَ الزُّورِ وَالْعَمَلَ بِهِ وَالْجَهْلَ فَلَيْسَ لِلَّهِ حَاجَةٌ أَنْ يَدَعَ طَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ
p: Man lam yadaʿ qawla-z-zūri wa-l-ʿamala bihi wa-l-jahl, fa-laysa lillāhi ḥājatun an yadaʿa ṭaʿāmahu wa sharābah
m: Whoever does not give up false speech and acting on it, and ignorance, Allah has no need of his giving up his food and his drink.
